title: Coast to Coast call drops at the lost-time question

tellings.quote: He wanted to know if I had had any lost time during the event and I was going to answer him and everything just went blank.

plain: While on Coast to Coast AM, a late-night radio show, Richard Barth, a former guard at a nuclear missile site who says he was abducted, was asked by the host George Noory whether he had any lost time during the event, a gap in memory people often report after such encounters. Barth says that just as he went to answer, "everything just went blank" and the call dropped.
